scope: 1 existing assets, separately privacy-cleaned native and FBX copies; originals preserved. GLB packages are separate. Not full registry completion.
functional_scope: Native bounded roof-window controls preserved: UNLOCK latch 0 to 1, OPEN_DEG 0 to 45. Sash opens only when UNLOCK >= 1. Saved plus 35 boundary/intermediate/out-of-range combinations and six ordered operation states per LOD matched source evaluated geometry/normals/hierarchy. Close before locking and unlock before opening. This is a logical visual interlock, not physical collision, watertightness or load certification. No 180-degree cleaning mode. Original FBX is static interchange without native drivers; no native-FBX functional parity or Unity certification.
original_source_publication_deduplicatio: Public-copy byte hashes differ from originals; this package is not a claim that the source asset was previously unpublished. GLB coverage and prior branch audit are separate.
